subject: POC prompt dataset & evaluation plan — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@acmehealth.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: POC prompt dataset & evaluation plan — next steps

Hi Alex & Priya,

Thanks again for the time earlier — great conversation and excited about the fit. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps to get the POC moving: 

Summary / success criteria (we covered on the call):
- Latency: 95th percentile inference latency <= 350ms for typical 256-token prompts under your batch profile.
- Quality: Top-1 answer accuracy >= 87% on the curated prompt set we'll collect (evaluation rubric attached).
- Cost: Per-token serving cost <= your target (we'll provide model/quantization recommendations to meet this).
- Reliability: No more than 1% error rate for 1k concurrent requests in our Dedicated test window.

POC scope & ownership:
- Acme Health: provide sample prompt set and representative logs (anonymized) — Priya will lead this.
- Redwood: build eval harness, run prompt set across model variants, provide result dashboard and suggested config.
- CS/Onboarding: Neha will coordinate data ingestion and access.

Timeline (proposed):
- Nov 26: You share sample prompts + logs (small subset) — we can start ingestion.
- Nov 30: Redwood returns initial eval plan and baseline run results on sample set.
- Dec 2–9: Full prompt set ingest and evaluation, iterative tuning.
- Dec 13: POC wrap-up demo + recommendations.

Attachments: POC_Eval_Template.xlsx (blank template for prompts + expected labels), sample evaluation rubric.

Next steps / asks for Acme Health:
1) Please upload a compressed CSV of ~200 representative prompts (with expected outputs when available) and a 24–48 hour snippet of API logs (anonymize PHI) to the Drive folder linked below.
2) Confirm the person who will own dataset uploads (Priya we discussed).
3) Any specific compliance constraints we should know about for handling logs during the POC (S3 region, encryption requirements, redaction?).

Drive for uploads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4d5AcmeHealth-POC-uploads

I’m looping Neha and Aditya on technical ingestion questions — happy to adjust timelines if you need more time to scrub logs.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset & evaluation plan — next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Priya and I reviewed and we can hit the proposed timelines. Quick notes: 

- We attached a small sample set (acme_prompts_sample.csv) — ~150 prompts, includes a mix of user support questions and triage intents. Each row has: prompt_id,prompt_text,expected_label (when available).
- Logs: attached acme_logs_snippet.txt (24-hour anonymized request/response pairs) — PHI removed.
- Compliance: We need Redwood to store logs in our us-east-1 S3 bucket (we'll provide a pre-signed upload link) and require AES-256 at rest. Can Neha advise on whether Redwood can support that for the POC?

Ownership: Priya will own the dataset upload. She will be the point for any clarifying questions about prompt labeling.

If everything looks good we'll upload the full dataset by EOD Dec 2. Let us know if you need more specifics on the log format.

Attachments: acme_prompts_sample.csv (text/csv, 36KB); acme_logs_snippet.txt (text/plain, 18KB)

Thanks,
Alex
Director, AI Product | Acme Health
alex.moore@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@acmehealth.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC prompt dataset & evaluation plan — next steps

Alex — perfect, thanks for sending the sample and the compliance note. Quick replies inline and next steps: 

- Storage & encryption: We can ingest into your us-east-1 S3 via a pre-signed upload and will keep the data in your bucket for the POC duration. We'll use AES-256. Neha — I’m assigning you to confirm the exact pre-signed workflow and minimal IAM/expiry needs.

- Sample review + plan: We’ll run the attached sample through two model configs (opt-quant and opt-fullfp) and return a short baseline report by Nov 30. That report will include top-line accuracy, latency distribution, and a short list of failure cases.

- Evaluation rubric: see the attached POC_Eval_Template.xlsx — please populate the expected_label column where possible and add a priority tag (high/medium/low) for critical prompts. That helps us prioritize tuning.

- Upload deadline: Dec 2 works for the full dataset. Once uploaded, please reply here with the upload link (or confirm pre-signed flow) so Neha can kick off ingestion.

Next internal tasks (for tracking):
- Neha: validate ingestion pipeline and S3 presigned setup; confirm encryption at rest.
- Aditya: prepare baseline run configs and a small test harness for the sample set.

Thanks — looking forward to the run.

Best,
Marissa
